output:
Some good news—and an honest update from me.

Priya Bhatia, a chartered structural engineer with nine years’ consultancy experience in Coventry, joins us on Monday 16 November. I’m genuinely delighted to welcome her. Her experience means we can get calculations and drawings moving more quickly, and I’m looking forward to you meeting her when she’s out on site.

I also want to acknowledge that our turnaround over September and October was not good enough. Beam calculations and drawings were taking 5–6 weeks, and several clients waited far too long. One couple in Harborne had their builder waiting with the steel already ordered. We got their calculations to them in three days, but only after they’d chased us twice. I’m sorry they—and others—had to deal with that. I saw the sharp review, and I understand why they were unhappy.

The slow weeks were my responsibility. I took on too much work alone. In October I was fitting in site visits during the day and calculations until midnight; my wife started calling the office “the other house”. That isn’t a sustainable way to look after clients, so I’m glad we’re making a change.

Our new target for beam calculations and drawings is **10 working days**. If you’re waiting on a job with us now, please message me directly. I’ll let you know where things stand and make sure your job is moving.

There’s one other change to share: first site visits taking place from **1 January 2027** will cost **£95**. If you go ahead with the work, that charge will be deducted from your fee. Any visit already booked when this post is published will remain free, whatever date it’s due to take place.

The free visit has been a nice way to start conversations, but around a third didn’t go on to become a job. Charging for visits helps us make better use of our time for the clients who do need our help.

I’m excited about what comes next, and grateful for your patience while we put things right. Please do say hello to Priya when she comes out to see you.
